title: Trinity #50 DC 2009 Kurt Busiek Mark Bagley Superman Weekly Series Cover
conditionDescription: Bright cover with light handling wear and a small corner ding at the lower left. See photos.
descriptionText:
Trinity #50 (May 13, 2009), DC Comics weekly series. Written by Kurt Busiek with Fabian Nicieza, art by Mark Bagley; Superman cover by Shane Davis. Direct sales, $2.99 cover price.

Back cover: X-Men Origins: Wolverine got milk? ad (Hugh Jackman).

Condition: bright cover with light handling wear and a small corner ding at the lower left (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
